name: PRTCATBL.jcl
description:
This JCL job (PRTCATBL) extracts transaction category balance data from a VSAM file, creates a backup copy, and produces a formatted, sorted report file. The report presents transaction category balances sorted by Account ID, Transaction Type Code, and Transaction Category Code, with balances formatted to two decimal places.Key Functionalities:
Deletes any pre-existing version of the report output file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.REPT) before processing begins, ensuring a clean run.
Unloads/copies the Transaction Category Balance VSAM KSDS file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS) into a new Generation Data Group (GDG) backup dataset with fixed-block records of 50 bytes each.
Sorts the backup data in ascending order by Account ID (positions 1-11), Transaction Type Code (positions 12-2), and Transaction Category Code (positions 14-4).
Formats the output report records (40 bytes, fixed-block) by arranging Account ID, Transaction Type Code, Transaction Category Code, and Transaction Category Balance (formatted as a numeric value with 2 decimal places, e.g., TTTTTTTTT.TT) separated by spaces, and saves the result as the final report file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.REPT).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Category Balance Report file (TCATBALF.REPT) may or may not exist from a previous job run
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Print Transaction Category Balance File job (PRTCATBL) is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Transaction Category Balance Report file exists, it must be deleted before any new report processing begins; if the file does not exist, the system acknowledges its absence and proceeds without error — ensuring a clean state for report generation in either case

rules.Rule_Name: DELDEF - IEFBR14 - Delete Existing Transaction Category Balance Report Before Regeneration
rules.Rule_Description: Before generating a new Transaction Category Balance Report, the system must ensure any previously existing report file is removed. This guarantees that the report always reflects only the latest data and no stale or partial report data persists from prior runs.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Category Balance master VSAM file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS) exists and is accessible in read-only shared mode, and a new generation of the backup file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.BKUP) is ready to be created with fixed-length 50-byte records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The REPRO utility is executed to copy all records from the Transaction Category Balance VSAM master file to the new backup generation file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Every record from the Transaction Category Balance VSAM master file is copied as-is — without any filtering or transformation — into the new versioned backup file (generation +1); the backup file is permanently saved and cataloged upon successful completion; if the copy operation fails for any reason, the incomplete backup file is automatically discarded and not cataloged, ensuring no partial or corrupt backup data is retained

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS - Full Backup of Transaction Category Balance File
rules.Rule_Description: This step creates a new versioned backup copy of the Transaction Category Balance master file by reproducing all records from the VSAM source into a sequential backup dataset. The backup preserves the complete state of the Transaction Category Balance data before any reporting activity begins.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Category Balance Backup file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.BKUP) is available and contains fixed-length records, where each record holds transaction category balance data for a cardholder account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads each record from the backup file for processing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Each record must be interpreted using the following field layout: Account ID (TRANCAT-ACCT-ID) occupies positions 1 through 11 as a numeric field; Transaction Type Code (TRANCAT-TYPE-CD) occupies positions 12 through 13 as a character field; Transaction Category Code (TRANCAT-CD) occupies positions 14 through 17 as a numeric field; Transaction Category Balance (TRAN-CAT-BAL) occupies positions 18 through 28 as a numeric field

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10R - SORT - Transaction Category Balance Record Layout Definition
rules.Rule_Description: Defines the field structure of each input record from the Transaction Category Balance Backup file, establishing the positions, lengths, and data types for all fields used in sorting and reporting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Category Balance Backup file contains one or more records with Account ID (TRANCAT-ACCT-ID), Transaction Type Code (TRANCAT-TYPE-CD), and Transaction Category Code (TRANCAT-CD) fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares records for the Transaction Category Balance Report
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All records must be sorted in the following strict priority order: first by Account ID (TRANCAT-ACCT-ID) in ascending order (lowest to highest), then within each Account ID by Transaction Type Code (TRANCAT-TYPE-CD) in ascending order (A to Z), then within each Transaction Type Code by Transaction Category Code (TRANCAT-CD) in ascending order (lowest to highest); records sharing the same Account ID, Transaction Type Code, and Transaction Category Code retain their original relative order

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10R - SORT - Transaction Category Balance Report Sort Order
rules.Rule_Description: Defines the mandatory sort sequence for all Transaction Category Balance records before they are written to the report, ensuring records are organized hierarchically by account, transaction type, and category.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A sorted Transaction Category Balance record containing Account ID (TRANCAT-ACCT-ID), Transaction Type Code (TRANCAT-TYPE-CD), Transaction Category Code (TRANCAT-CD), and Transaction Category Balance (TRAN-CAT-BAL) is ready to be written to the report
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system constructs each output record for the Transaction Category Balance Report
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Each output record must be structured in the following exact sequence: Account ID (TRANCAT-ACCT-ID) followed by one space separator, then Transaction Type Code (TRANCAT-TYPE-CD) followed by one space separator, then Transaction Category Code (TRANCAT-CD) followed by one space separator, then the formatted Transaction Category Balance amount, followed by 9 trailing spaces; the total output record length must be 40 bytes with fixed-length formatting

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10R - SORT - Transaction Category Balance Report Output Record Structure
rules.Rule_Description: Defines the exact structure and field arrangement of each output record written to the Transaction Category Balance Report, including field selection, ordering, and spacing between fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Transaction Category Balance (TRAN-CAT-BAL) value is an 11-digit numeric field stored in raw numeric format within the Transaction Category Balance Backup record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the Transaction Category Balance amount for output in the Transaction Category Balance Report
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The balance amount must be formatted using the pattern TTTTTTTTT.TT, where: leading zeros in the integer portion are suppressed and not displayed (e.g., a value of 000012345678 is displayed as 123456.78); a decimal point is inserted to separate the integer portion (up to 9 digits) from the fractional portion; exactly 2 decimal digits are always displayed after the decimal point; the resulting formatted balance occupies a fixed 12-character output field (9 integer digit positions + 1 decimal point + 2 decimal digit positions)

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10R - SORT - Transaction Category Balance Amount Formatting
rules.Rule_Description: Defines how the raw numeric Transaction Category Balance amount must be transformed into a human-readable decimal format with suppressed leading zeros and exactly two decimal places for display in the report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The SORT utility has completed sorting and formatting all Transaction Category Balance records and is ready to write the output report file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.REPT)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system finalizes the Transaction Category Balance Report generation step
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the sort and formatting operation completes successfully, the report file must be permanently saved and cataloged as AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.REPT for business consumption; if the sort and formatting operation fails for any reason, the incomplete report file must be automatically discarded and not retained, ensuring no partial or incorrect report is made available to business users

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10R - SORT - Transaction Category Balance Report File Creation
rules.Rule_Description: Defines the conditions under which the Transaction Category Balance Report file is permanently saved or discarded, ensuring only a fully and successfully generated report is retained for business use.
